notes: Five own pages read in pass 1, all HTTP 200 and not thin. The pricing page was already in the cache from an earlier read (key 6ef8b1ac01e6fb59) and was reused, not refetched. The integrations page (key 2a0b81a2e66d343f) renders its partner directory client side, so its text snapshot names no partners. Pass 2 (8 Oct 2026): no browser snapshot exists for Fieldwire; under the clarification for script-loaded directories, two individual integration pages were read once with fetch-once (Primavera P6, key 4a03a6b9db7c848e; Sage Intacct, key 26566fb026591f13; seven pages in all). They settle C19 (Sage), C20 (Viewpoint, from the Sage page's related list of Viewpoint Vista and Spectrum) and C22 (Primavera P6), re-classed from unverifiable to true. C18 (Procore) and C21 (CMiC) stay unverifiable: neither appears on any page read; for the reviewer only, the raw HTML of the directory has no Procore or CMiC entry, which was not used to class. Pass 2 also added C25 (has a mobile app, six instances) because the clarifications make 'has a mobile app' a platforms claim; pass 1 had treated generic mobile mentions as capabilities. 'Mobile-first', 'mobile access' and offline lines were still not coded. Gap lines and tables added nothing else: the table cells 'Free (up to 5 users)', 'Free / $39/user/mo' and 'Free tier + paid plans' repeat claims their answers already carry, and the Foundation integration line is about eSub. No claim is wrong or stale, so no cited page was read for causes. C17 (over 1,000,000 projects) is classed true as a lower bound of the published more than 4,000,000. One cited own page (staging.fieldwire.com) was not read.
